action.previous_action: selected raw 9-vector, before physical actuator conversion

state_scaler.binding: embedded state is bound by the checkpoint SHA256

success_definition.first_lift: diagnostic first lift in one episode; never substitutes for stable hold
success_definition.stable_hold: continuous lift satisfying lift/distance checks, completed before physical failure
success_definition.evaluation_start: normal reset; no teacher rollout or RSI

observation_schemas.teacher: shape features, object pose, robot state, base velocity, object relative velocity, 30 grasp candidates, previous raw action
observation_schemas.student: 3 causal image frames; front mask, wrist mask, front masked depth, wrist masked depth; robot proprioception and previous raw action
